problems.problem: The prompt-generated 'oblique slab' at the top renders as a perspective 3D plank with beveled edges and a cast edge-shadow, while the three deterministic rectangles render as flat semi-transparent overlays; two incompatible geometry languages coexist. The brief's 'hard-edge flat stacked slabs with one blank celadon seam parallel to the disc axis' is not what appears: the plank's perspective tilt contradicts the bottle's flat frontal light and the axis-aligned rects.

The 0.85-opacity graphite rectangle (194,202,540,230) sits almost entirely in empty celadon to the left of the bottle and reads as a void hole; the brief intends slabs to pass behind the product shoulder ('矩形从其肩后掠过'), so the darkest slab currently carries no product relationship.

The bottle's contact shadow (visible in the base crop as a soft dark smear at y≈905) lands inside the 0.35-opacity rectangle (454,720,540,230), so the product appears to stand on a translucent overlay patch rather than on a defined slab plane; the supporting slab's top edge is nowhere near the base line, weakening the 'standing before the slab step' read.

The lower-left plaque zone is under-built: ~150px of dead celadon between the title baseline block (ends y=1187) and the graphite rule at y=1339, and the rule (width 324) is narrower than the title block (~389px), so the 'section刻度' line does not visually close the type column.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte screen-printed card in pale celadon green, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, absolutely flat graphic field with no perspective, no depth, no bevels, no cast shadows, no texture gradients, no objects
